questions.prompt: Solid sodium chloride does not conduct electricity because…
In which solvent are ionic compounds usually insoluble?
Calcium (2,8,8,2) reacts with oxygen (2,6). Which formula?
Which pair would form an ionic compound?
Describe how sodium chloride forms from sodium and chlorine atoms, including electron arrangements.
questions.modelAnswer: Sodium (2, 8, 1) loses its one outer electron to become Na⁺ (2, 8). Chlorine (2, 8, 7) gains that electron to become Cl⁻ (2, 8, 8). Both ions now have full outer shells. The oppositely charged ions attract strongly, forming ionic bonds in a giant lattice of NaCl.
rubric: Opposite charges attract in a lattice
